title: story-026's own intent makes an external, post-deploy-ZERO contract a hard precondition of the only permissionless entry point (Law 1 over Law 2 — unsafe story)
fingerprintBasis: sha256(src/StableYieldAccumulator.sol:claim:story-intended-mandatory-external-dependency-no-fallback-on-sole-permissionless-entry-point)  [entryPoint null -> legacy hash form, byte-identical to pre-entryPoint findings]
description: A SYA whose owner sets nudgeSplit > 0 before setNudgeStreamer has a fully bricked claim rail; the conversion pipeline and every downstream ClaimArbitrage run stall until the owner acts. Verified: nudgeStreamer is a setter-only field defaulting to address(0), and a payable-nudge claim in that state reverts NudgeStreamerNotConfigured() (0xb94406b2) — Tier-3 test_P1_D.
impact: A SYA whose owner sets nudgeSplit > 0 before setNudgeStreamer has a fully bricked claim rail; the conversion pipeline and every downstream ClaimArbitrage run stall until the owner acts. Verified: nudgeStreamer is a setter-only field defaulting to address(0), and a payable-nudge claim in that state reverts NudgeStreamerNotConfigured() (0xb94406b2) — Tier-3 test_P1_D.
attackPath: No attacker. This is a design adjudication under Law 1 over Law 2.
1. story-026 deliberately deletes the safeTransfer fallback with no try/catch envelope.
2. claim() liveness therefore depends on NudgeStreamer.streams[nudge][rewardToken].duration != 0 — state in a separately-deployed contract whose post-deploy default is unset.
3. Any ordering error, any repoint, or simply enabling the split before wiring the streamer takes the only permissionless entry point offline.
recommendation: Owner decision, not a code fix, is what this finding asks for: either accept the mandatory-dependency design and record the acceptance as a REAL triage artefact (see F-02), or restore a bounded degradation path — e.g. a try/catch envelope that routes the nudge share to phlimbo on streamer failure, or an owner-settable `nudgeFallbackToPhlimbo` flag. If accepted as-is, add a `nudgeRailArmed()` view that probes the full four-step precondition so ops can verify the runbook before enabling the split.
conformanceNote: All seven of story-026's explicit acceptance criteria are SATISFIED, including RED/GREEN TDD discipline with zero test lines edited in the GREEN commit. This finding does not allege a deviation — it flags the story's intent as the source of the exposure. Under Law 1 a faithful implementation of an unsafe design is escalated, not blessed.
doubleCountingNoteStruck: The classifier's doubleCountingNote is STRUCK per the severity revision. F-01 stands on its OWN MERITS: it binds at t=0 before value flows, and is unilaterally escapable via setNudgeSplit(0). Do not present it as merely the design shadow of M-01.
writeUpConstraint: This finding asks for an OWNER DECISION, not a code fix. Write it up that way.
